definition_zh: 仁慈；善行；善举；（对人的）恩惠
definition_en: the quality of being kind and generous, or a kind and generous act
core_image: 寒冬里张开的一只递出热汤的手
scene: 灾民排队领粥，施粥棚冒着白汽。Her quiet beneficence fed the whole village through the famine.
sceneCN: 这里 beneficence 是「善行、恩惠」（第 2 个义项：具体的善举）；句意是她默默的善举让全村人熬过了饥荒。

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「仁慈的；行善的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「仁慈地」
同根近义词，义为「仁爱；善心」

senses.title: The quality of doing good
senses.definition: the inner quality of wishing and doing good to others
senses.definitionCN: 乐于待人、行善的内在品质
senses.example: The committee honoured a lifetime of beneficence.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会表彰了其一生的仁慈善行。
senses.why: Bene means well and facere means to do, so the quality is well-doing.
senses.whyCN: bene 意为「好」，facere 意为「做」，合起来即「行善」的品质。

senses.title: A kind and generous act
senses.definition: a concrete act of kindness or generosity, often with money or aid
senses.definitionCN: 具体的善行义举，常见于出资施助
senses.example: Her quiet beneficence fed the whole village through the famine.
senses.exampleCN: 她默默的善举让全村人熬过了饥荒。
senses.why: The doing of good hardens into the deed itself.
senses.whyCN: 「行善」的品质凝结为一件件善事本身。

senses.title: The ethical duty to help others
senses.definition: in ethics, the obligation to act for the benefit of others
senses.definitionCN: 伦理学中「应当助人」的原则，如医学伦理的行善原则
senses.example: Medical ethics lists beneficence among its core principles.
senses.exampleCN: 医学伦理把行善原则列为核心原则之一。
senses.why: The moral sense of well-doing becomes a named duty.
senses.whyCN: 「行善」的道德感被确立为一条命名了的义务。

intro.en: Beneficence is Latin bene, well, plus facere, to do, plus the noun suffix -ence.
intro.cn: beneficence 由拉丁语 bene「好」加 facere「做」再加名词后缀 -ence 构成。

items.en: the root dhe- meant to set, to do.
items.cn: 词根 dhe- 意为「放置、做」（重构形式）。
拉丁语 beneficentia 意为「行善、仁慈」。

items.en: beneficence passed through French into learned use.
items.cn: 该词经古法语进入学术用法。

items.en: English borrowed beneficence in the fifteenth century.
items.cn: 十五世纪英语借入 beneficence。

items.en: it now also names a formal principle in moral philosophy.
items.cn: 如今还作为道德哲学中行善原则的正式名称。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bene- or fic- roots; the near-meaning group gathers kindness words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bene- 或 fic- 词根；近义组汇集仁慈类词。

entries.definition: the doing of evil or harm
entries.definitionCN: 作恶——前缀相反的对照词
益处——同含 bene- 与 fic- 词根

normalIntro.en: Beneficence is bene plus facere plus -ence: well-doing.
normalIntro.cn: beneficence 是 bene 加 facere 加 -ence：行善之质。

normal.en: Doctors know the principle of beneficence.
Do not confuse with benefit, the result.
normal.cn: 不要与表结果的 benefit 混淆。

abstract.en: See steam rising from a soup ladle in winter.
abstract.cn: 看寒冬里汤勺升起的白汽。

abstract.en: Feel a warm coat laid on cold shoulders.
Picture an open hand with no string attached.
abstract.cn: 想象一只不附带条件的手。

examples.en: Her quiet beneficence fed the whole village through the famine.
examples.cn: 她默默的善举让全村人熬过了饥荒。

examples.en: The committee honoured a lifetime of beneficence.
examples.cn: 委员会表彰了其一生的仁慈善行。

examples.en: Medical ethics lists beneficence among its core principles.
examples.cn: 医学伦理把行善原则列为核心原则之一。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「杯你的身斯」——一杯热汤递到你身前，这样的人斯文又仁慈。

root: 拉丁语 bene「好地」加 facere「做」（词根上溯至原始印欧语 dhe-「放置、做」，重构形式），派生 beneficentia「行善、仁慈」，经古法语于十五世纪进入英语。同根词有 beneficent、benefit、maleficence 等。

sensesIntro.en: One noun moves from a kind heart to kind deeds and then to a named moral duty.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个名词，从仁慈之心，落到善行义举，再立为一条道德义务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand ladling hot soup in the cold.
core.cn: 核心意象：寒冬里递出热汤的手。

intro.en: Beneficence fixes the doing root fac- inside a noun of quality.
intro.cn: beneficence 把「做」词根 fac- 固定进品质名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin pair bene and facere heads this family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 bene 与 facere 的组合统领这个词族。

items.meaning: kind generosity or a kind act

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「仁慈的」
由形容词加副词后缀构成，义为「仁慈地」
